list: The official 55 trophies, verified 19 Nov 2026 against Exophase's public list and PSNProfiles (the two agree on every name, description and grade). 28 of the 55 are hidden on PlayStation until earned.
sources_note: Every trophy's name, description and grade are PlayStation's own words, as Exophase and PSNProfiles list them. Counts (PSN progress targets such as 42 shooting-range challenges) come from PSNProfiles. Every guide is our own words, written from the official description — the game is a day old and no complete guide exists yet, so where a place is not pinned down we say so instead of inventing one.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Follow the roadmap in order and it will arrive last, right after 100% completion. If it has not popped, the checklist shows exactly which trophies are left.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to its end — it is the game's first mission, so this pops in your first session. Nothing to prepare and nothing to miss: the story carries you through it.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Chapters run in order, so keep playing the story and this arrives on its own. It is the first of the four chapter trophies — the roadmap's stage 2 shows what follows.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it cannot be missed — it pops when the chapter's last mission ends. Check the roadmap's stage 2 to see the story spine in order.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. The chapter trophies arrive in story order, so there is no way to skip past this one — play the story and it comes. Use the checklist to tick off the missions as you go.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4, the last chapter before the finale. Once it pops, only the final mission stands between you and the gold story trophy. Nothing here is missable — the story carries you through.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission — the story's last beat, after Chapter 4. It is one of only two gold trophies, and it cannot be missed: every player who finishes the story earns it. Save the 100% cleanup for after the credits.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Named story missions like this one sit inside the chapters, so play the story in order and it will come up — the roadmap's stage 3 lists every named mission in its place.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Heists are story beats, so this one arrives as you play through — no preparation needed, and nothing about it can be missed. Tick it off when it pops.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. It is one of the named story missions in stage 3 of the roadmap — play the story in order and it comes up on its own.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Another named story mission: it pops when the mission ends, and the story will not let you skip past it. Keep it ticked in the checklist so the roadmap stays honest.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown, the airport takedown. It is a story mission, so it cannot be missed — but remember the airport afterwards: the 'unscheduled departure' trophy (Catch Me If You Can) is a separate, missable-flagged stunt at the same location.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. The last of the six named story missions in stage 3 — finish it and the mission-strand stage is nearly done. Like the rest, it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the game's own checklist of story, missions, collectibles and activities, tracked 0 to 100 by PlayStation. This is the long one: it only pops once every other strand of the game is done, so treat it as the finish line, not a task. The second gold trophy, and the last stop before the platinum.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. PSN target 100: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses, drifts and air time, counted 0 to 250 by PlayStation. Stunts build up naturally whenever you drive hard, so do not grind them early: play normally, then mop up the remainder late by chaining jumps off ramps and hills. Any vehicle counts; a fast bike makes the count climb quickest.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. PSN target 250: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — PlayStation tracks 0 to 9. The types are the game's side activities (races, fishing, arcade, shooting range, drone races, meditation, hunting, bowling and the rest); one try at each is enough, you do not need to finish or win any of them. Do this early in stage 4 and it unlocks the rest of the activities stage.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. PSN target 9 activity types: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — PlayStation tracks 0 to 42. This is a skill trophy, not a grind: learn each range's rhythm, use the steadiest weapon you own, and take the challenges in short sessions rather than all at once. Gold on every challenge is the hard part; the count only moves when a challenge is gold, so a silver does not count.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. PSN target 42: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — PlayStation tracks 0 to 14. Each location is its own race, so you need a win at every one, not 14 wins anywhere. Learn the racing line at each spot, cut corners where the course allows, and leave the hardest location for last when your flying is sharpest.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. PSN target 14: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — PlayStation tracks 0 to 20, and the word different matters: the same race won twice counts once. Work through the race list across Leonida (street, off-road and water where offered), ticking each new win off, and save the ones you lose for a second pass with a better vehicle.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. PSN target 20: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge — a head-to-head against a named character, not open fishing. Take it the first time Cal offers it: a challenge against a story character may not come back, so we flag it missable. Bring your best rod, watch Cal's pace, and reel steady rather than fast.
trophies.missable_note: Flagged from the official description: a challenge against a named character (Cal) that may only be offered once. Not yet confirmed in the game — do it the first time it appears.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — any machine, any game, one full playthrough to its end. Arcades are scattered around Leonida; pick the shortest game on the cabinet and finish it. You do not need a high score, just a completion.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission — the last job in his strand. Contact strands end with a final mission each (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone); finish every strand's missions in order and the final one pops. The roadmap's stage 3 lists all five contacts together.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission — the last job in his strand. Strands are done by playing their missions as they appear; there is no separate checklist to follow beyond finishing each contact's last mission. Pair it with Andy's, Billy's, Randy's and Tyrone's finals in stage 3.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission — the last job in his strand. Like the other contact finals it pops when the mission ends, and it cannot be missed as long as you play the strand through. Keep all five contact finals ticked in stage 3.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida — PlayStation tracks 0 to 8. Strangers appear across the map with their own short mission chains; do a strand when you meet its stranger rather than leaving them all for the end, since some may only appear in certain chapters. This is the silver of stage 3.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. PSN target 8: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission — the last job in his strand. Randy's strand, like the others, ends with a named final mission; finish it and one more contact is done. Four of the five contact finals share stage 3 with the stranger strands.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission — the last job in his strand, and the fifth contact final. Once Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone are all done, stage 3 of the roadmap is complete. Nothing in a contact strand is missable — just play each mission as it comes.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida — PlayStation tracks 0 to 18. Meditation spots are quiet places spread over the map; visit each one and meditate there. Work through them region by region while you explore (stage 5), so you are not criss-crossing the map twice.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. PSN target 18: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — a single specific animal, not general hunting. Talk to Bret to learn which animal he wants, then track it in its habitat. Bring a scoped rifle and approach downwind; a unique animal will not respawn for a second try in the same session, so make the first shot count.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets — PlayStation tracks 0 to 3. Cards are hidden around Leonida in sets; a set only counts when every card in it is found. Collect as you explore (stage 5) rather than hunting cards blind: sweep one region at a time and tick each set off when it completes.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. PSN target 3: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations — PlayStation tracks 0 to 100. WAiNK spots are marked around Leonida; visit each one and use the WAiNK interaction there. This is the biggest collectible count in the game, so fold it into your map sweep in stage 5 and do it region by region.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. PSN target 100: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges — PlayStation tracks 0 to 50. Challenges are the game's small feats (stunts, driving, combat and more); they tick over while you play everything else, so do not chase them first. Check the challenge list late in stage 4 and mop up the ones still undone.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. PSN target 50: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape. Build the wanted level to 4 stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until it clears. We flag it missable: partner availability is chapter-limited, so do it while your partner is around in the story.
trophies.missable_note: Flagged from the official description: it needs your partner beside you, and partner availability is chapter-limited. Not yet confirmed in the game — do it while a partner is with you.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, keeping your wanted level the whole way — one run, three shops, no losing the heat between them. Plan a short route through three shops, keep the getaways quick, and do not stop to fight. Flagged missable: it needs your partner, so attempt it while a partner is available in the story.
trophies.missable_note: Flagged from the official description: three robberies in one run with your partner, and partner availability is chapter-limited. Not yet confirmed in the game — attempt it while a partner is with you.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — PlayStation tracks 0 to 100. A vehicle counts when you first find and enter it, so variety is the goal: drive everything you see, from scooters to trucks, and sweep car parks and dealerships. This pairs naturally with the map sweep in stage 5.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. PSN target 100: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus — one activation, five downs. Wait for a group of enemies bunched together, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns before it ends. A busy shootout is the best place to try it; if you only get three or four, reload and try the same fight again.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport — leave VCIA in a way no timetable allows, by stealing a plane and taking off. Flagged missable: it is tied to a specific airport moment, so attempt it the first time you are at VCIA with a plane in reach, rather than assuming the airport stays open the same way all game.
trophies.missable_note: Flagged from the official description: an unscheduled departure at a specific place (VCIA). Not yet confirmed in the game — try it the first time you reach the airport.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos — the tanks. The description is a joke, not an instruction: the trophy is about surviving or defeating tank encounters. Bring heavy weapons, keep moving so the cannon cannot track you, and use cover between shots. It pops when the tank encounter is resolved your way.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — a clean job, no alarms, no witnesses spotting you. Case the store first, go in quiet, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again later; detection fails the attempt, not the trophy.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape — PlayStation tracks 0 to 5. Each vault is its own job: get in, crack the vault, and get out clean. Plan the escape route before you go in, keep the wanted level manageable, and count each successful escape; the silver pops on the fifth.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. PSN target 5: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida — stop one, crack it open, take the cash and get away before the response arrives. A quiet road with a fast getaway car beats a busy street; escape first, count the cash later.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — PlayStation tracks 0 to 52. An area counts when you set foot in it, so this is a map-completion trophy: sweep the state region by region, from Vice City out to the swamps and keys, and watch the counter climb. Fold the card sets, WAiNK spots and meditation spots into the same sweep.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. PSN target 52: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — PlayStation tracks 0 to 9. Each gang runs its own operations around Leonida; hit one operation per gang and the trophy pops. Keep a note of which gangs you have done, since the operations look alike from the street.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. PSN target 9: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — find a bar or vendor on the beachfront, order a cocktail, and take it in with the ocean in front of you. It is a breather trophy: do it between story beats, and it pops when the drink is in hand.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive straight through the glass, the way the old games taught us. We flag it missable: a showroom smash reads like a scripted set-piece moment, so attempt it the first time a showroom presents itself rather than assuming every showroom can be smashed later.
trophies.missable_note: Flagged from the official description: smashing out of a showroom reads like a scripted set-piece moment. Not yet confirmed in the game — try it the first time you see a showroom.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — bowl a game there. The alley is a named location, so head to it, play a frame, and the trophy pops. Pair it with the other activity trophies in stage 4.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — a moment between the two leads that the public notices. The description is deliberately vague (it is a story beat, and we will not spoil it here). Play the story and it arrives on its own; if it has not popped by the finale, check the story trophies you have left.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.guide: Make choices — PlayStation tracks them 0 to 500. Choices appear throughout the story and the open world: dialogue picks, mission approaches, and small decisions all count. This is a slow burn: play naturally and the counter climbs, but remember that story choices are one-time, so we flag it missable — a choice you never see cannot be made twice.
trophies.missable_note: Flagged from the official description: story choices are one-time, and some only appear in specific missions. Not yet confirmed in the game — make every choice the story offers you.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. PSN target 500: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try — fail something, then do it right the second time. The description says it all: this one wants a retry. If you succeed at everything first time, you may never see it, so we flag it missable: when a challenge lets you retry, take the retry rather than reloading a save.
trophies.missable_note: Flagged from the official description: it needs a second attempt, so succeeding first time everywhere may remove the chance. Not yet confirmed in the game — retry rather than reload when you fail.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — a one-off oddity somewhere in Leonida. The description is the whole clue: something happens, you stare at it, the trophy pops. We flag it missable because a strange event is easy to walk past; keep your eyes open in the odd corners of the map, especially at night.
trophies.missable_note: Flagged from the official description: a strange one-off event that is easy to walk past. Not yet confirmed in the game — explore the odd corners of the map.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl someone over with a melee drive-by — strike a person with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. Line up a slow pass, swing as you go by, and keep the speed low enough to aim. A quiet street with a pedestrian is the practice ground; the trophy pops on the hit.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts — PlayStation tracks 0 to 250,000. Marked Bills come from jobs; launder them through your contacts a little at a time, and the total climbs. Do not hoard bills until the end: launder as you earn, and this finishes alongside the story.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. PSN target 250,000: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — PlayStation tracks 0 to 100,000. Clothes, weapons, food, vehicle mods: everything you buy counts. Spend as you play rather than saving it all for a spree, and the counter will be close to done by the time you are mopping up.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. PSN target 100,000: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties — PlayStation tracks 0 to 8. Garages are bought around Leonida; each one is a property purchase, and the eighth completes the set. Buy them as you find them (and as your wallet allows) rather than leaving all eight for the endgame.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. PSN target 8: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own words from the official description.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — PlayStation tracks 0 to 10. Find ten different vehicles, open the Scooter Bros app, and register each one. Any vehicle counts, so register the ones you discover while sweeping the map in stage 5.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase. PSN target 10: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own words from the official description.
